name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: I wasn’t sure what to expect
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1497%2E135344%2EBbfN28)

When I first decided I was going to run for the United States Senate, I had no idea what to expect. I had won three tough elections, but running statewide for the first time is a whole other ball of wax.
I knew that I had a number of friends and supporters from previous campaigns who would be there to support me, but I also knew it would take a grassroots campaign much larger than any I'd run before to be successful.
So on February 27, 2023, we officially launched my Senate campaign at around 8am. Our press release went out and our video went up online. And then we waited....
Four minutes later, we received a $10 donation from Michele, a customer care representative from Plymouth, Michigan. Five minutes later, a student at Michigan State chipped in $5. Less than a minute later, Ryan from Grawn, Michigan gave $100 and we were off...
More than 150,000 donations later and we're on our way to running the kind of campaign that can overcome our opponent's fundraising AND the super PACs spending to beat us.
Those donations have kept us in the race, but the spending against us has picked up, and that means we need our donations to do the same. So with our next FEC fundraising deadline on June 30th, I am asking:
[**Can I count on you to contribute $5, $10, $50 or whatever you can afford to my campaign for Senate? This is a must-win seat that we can't win without your continued support between now and November.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240603-1-sa&t=2&akid=1497%2E135344%2EBbfN28)

God bless President Trump!

_**During this dark time for our great nation, we must surround President Trump with the LOVE and JOY of our MAGA movement. **_

So we wrote this big, beautiful letter to express our affection and gratitude for all he has done for us and America.

But we still need **1 Million more MAGA patriots** to add their names to this letter before we can deliver it.

[**Will you show President Trump your love right now and sign your name to this beautiful letter?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7he93ju88afn213ka88gmsegedocc3mevd7ouog_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c5j69ob6cdh2bs "Will you show President Trump your love right now and sign your name to this beautiful letter?")

Dear President Trump,

God bless you!

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

Thats why:

WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

Global Disaster Briefs are your weekly (or more often, if needed) summaries and headlines from around the world about natural and man-made disasters, climate change, disease and health, and international conflict. See endnotes for resources used in putting this report together. Data is retrieved and summarized on the day of publication unless otherwise noted.
[Click here to support my work](https://substack.com/redirect/ed185b86-488f-4775-96ec-d78bd634642e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
### **Meteorological/Climatological**
The UN [has confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/51a8d55e-9e07-4b81-859c-badfc0ba118d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least 670 deaths and possibly 2,000 persons assumed to be buried after a massive landslide in **Papua New Guinea** on May 24, 2024. Prime Minister James Marape made his first visit to the site of the disaster on Friday, May 31.
> **Ways to help those impacted by landslides in Papua New Guinea:**
> * [Doctors without Borders](https://substack.com/redirect/ad3519ff-910d-46b2-9639-ef0bf8ccd2fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([98% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/977967a3-a133-4eec-a97d-b86f1460b68c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)*)
> * [USA for IOM](https://substack.com/redirect/4dbc4fad-d474-4b72-b064-2cf4b3d762e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([88% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/8e1ba4c6-acc9-492b-bf91-4b007e7390a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
> * [Oxfam](https://substack.com/redirect/900e9bc4-c0d1-48b4-ac4f-37534a1bd06f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([98% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/9a1ee50f-4f1e-456b-80b2-1212f5461372?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
> * [UNICEF](https://substack.com/redirect/dcdf71ab-6ecc-46ee-afb4-831d2336106b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([92% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/222af1ab-1f05-464c-9675-9397311d0367?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

#### **Hurricane Season Updates:**
The Atlantic Hurricane season officially started Saturday, June 1, 2024.
There are currently no active tropical systems in any oceanic basin.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/04cc0bb1-862e-4a44-93e0-89eb88586249?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
### **Geological**
181 earthquakes ranging from 3 to 6.2 magnitude on the Richter scale[ have been reported ](https://substack.com/redirect/5bdc4c5b-3bef-4327-8217-b9aee4e3e536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)since the last [brief published on May 28, 2024.](https://substack.com/redirect/22f7827d-3fae-4784-925c-717bcdeb94bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The[ Global Volcanism Program](https://substack.com/redirect/da19c6a8-c218-4c59-8441-12fc3f55d456?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a program of the Smithsonian Institution, reported 27 volcanoes in active eruption status last week. New eruptions include Iceland's Reykjanes, and Mount Dempo in Indonesia. An ash advisory[ is currently in effect for Sumatra](https://substack.com/redirect/bbede388-6633-4d5b-b764-cf775efa603b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6bdeafc5-be8d-4d7b-8a04-cf7266019e91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
### **International News**
##### AFGHANISTAN: Taliban Praises Russian Plan to Remove Its Terrorist Designation
Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov[ told Russian media ](https://substack.com/redirect/69893773-2853-48e8-a15e-87e0802c7cfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)on May 27 that the Taliban "hold real power" in Afghanistan and that Moscow is planning to remove them from its list of terrorist organizations.
##### AZERBAIJAN: Azerbaijan President Announced Resettlement of Nagorno-Karabakh Capital Will Start in September
Baku will [begin efforts to resettle](https://substack.com/redirect/23baf005-3ced-4d3f-97cb-2d4385e94cbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the region's capital in September, President Ilham Aliyev said; Azerbaijan carried out a military campaign last fall in what was previously an ethnic Armenian enclave.
##### CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: United States Sanctions Two Firms That Supported Wagner Group
The [Wagner Group](https://substack.com/redirect/2f66de4d-06c7-44b0-a24c-a648a1d17fb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a Russian firm [accused of](https://substack.com/redirect/bcfa867b-84b1-43c5-89ff-dcd9f7d3eb44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) exacerbating instability in the region. The Wagner Group and its leader, Yevgeny Prigozhin, provide guns for hire in a murky global operation with links to Putin and the Russian state.
##### HAITI: Haiti's Transitional Government Names New Prime Minister
The[ council selected ](https://substack.com/redirect/9232b898-8c9d-41ac-b41a-aca3a85f09a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)longtime international aid official Garry Conille as prime minister, tasking him with liaising with a multinational security mission and leading the country toward new presidential elections. Conille served briefly as Haiti's prime minister more than a decade ago and has worked 25 years with aid agencies, including the United Nations.
##### MEXICO: [Mexico elects Claudia Sheinbaum as its first female president](https://substack.com/redirect/15f0da26-17b1-41d7-a1fc-b7c15a0c3e78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Mexico's newly-elected President comes from an [academic background](https://substack.com/redirect/0419abd8-48fe-474b-9117-e51924f14758?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a Ph.D. physicist and climate scientist, having published more than 100 peer-reviewed articles and serving on the 2018 Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC). ...

name: Andrew Yang
subject: Is Local News the Answer?
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=cf773cf83e&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
America is more polarized than ever – and one big reason why is that local newspapers have disappeared.

Over 2,000 local papers have gone out of business in the last 15 years – thirteen hundred communities in the US now have no local news source at all. Local papers tend(ed) to be much more straight-up-the-middle, as there aren’t that many ways to report on the bridge needing repair or how the local high school team is doing.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=e3bca71950&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
As you can imagine I’ve interacted with hundreds of journalists over the past number of years, and I can say with confidence that local journalists are much less interested in trying to stick it to you and much more invested in getting the word out about something that might matter to the people in town. As one reporter put it, “We report things responsibly because we are going to see the person the next day.” I sat with dozens of editorial boards of papers in New Hampshire and Iowa. Half of those papers are now closing or closed and over 30,000 local journalism jobs have disappeared over the past number of years.

Fewer people run for office after a local paper goes down and the cost of municipal financing goes up – apparently you don’t care as much about the kind of deal you get if no one is reporting on it. I spoke to a city councilman who saw a marked difference in the behavior at meetings when a reporter stopped coming; people started saying and doing things they never would have done with a reporter present. The quality of government goes down.

Also, it turns out that one’s media diet corresponds very strongly to, for example, one’s propensity to support Trump. Trump is underwater with newspaper readers by a whopping 49 points while he’s up among social media users by 4 points, cable news watchers by 8 points and among YouTubers by 16. Newspaper readers are more likely to have trust in institutions.

There is a scrappy organization – the Rebuild Local News Coalition – that is trying to reverse the tide. I spoke to its founder and President, Steve Waldman, on the [podcast](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=26e90a3462&e=0f227c2ae3) this week. Steve and I have known each other for a while – we both went to Brown University and he started Report for America a number of years ago. “There is growing momentum around supporting local papers from both sides of the aisle. It turns out it’s a source of civic pride for most towns, the same way a sports team might be in another community. And everyone loves small businesses.” Steve notes that legislators at both the state levels and federally are now rallying around tax credits for both local papers and the small businesses that advertise in them. “Fixing this problem at the local level might cost $1 billion a year.”

Steve notes that the big tech companies have a special responsibility as both beneficiaries of some of the content that these newspapers generate as well as the cause of their demise. “It’s fair and reasonable to ask the biggest tech companies – the ones that have benefited the most from this new reality – to spend a tiny portion of their revenue to solve the significant problem they helped create.” Steve sees more optimism around the Community News and Small Business Support Act than he’s seen in some time.

The decimation of local papers is an underrated cause of the decline in our politics. Could something as simple as having a reporter in your town show up to things and write them up in an objective way help restore our sense of trust? I personally am convinced that many towns could support a local publication if it didn’t need to enjoy double-digit profit margins and a boffo growth rate. Some things aren’t meant to be profit engines – but are still positives that lead to a better way of life. Communities telling stories about themselves falls in that category.

For my interview with Steve Waldman of the [Rebuild Local News Coalition](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=f2524e7588&e=0f227c2ae3) click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9efa67e680&e=0f227c2ae3). To see what Forward is doing in your state click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=47ee1423b8&e=0f227c2ae3). For more about the media landscape check out my book [Forward](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=ed0982d9e7&e=0f227c2ae3) which goes into its impact on polarization in some detail.

My TED Talk is up to 1.2 million views – please do [share](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=6d88bd2c24&e=0f227c2ae3) it with anyone you think would enjoy it!
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

subject: 2 Weeks from Tomorrow

body:
| | |
---
It's Monday in America! The Primary Election is just two weeks from tomorrow. We've recently announced my final 17 day blitz all over Virginia. I'll be visiting a total of 70 locations, meeting directly with voters, and sharing my campaign message. Yesterday, I closed the weekend in Arlington with an energized group of supporters - including Morton Blackwell. Morton was re-elected on Saturday to his 10th! term as RNC Committeeman. I'm grateful for Morton's support and endorsement. He's a conservative legend, a winner, and a good friend.
---
---
I had a good time on Saturday at the Republican Party of Virginia's convention. I also congratulate Patti Lyman on her re-election as RNC Committeewoman. Morton and Patti's races were hard-fought for many months, but I'm sure they agree with me that these campaigns will make them perform even better in these important positions with the RNC. It's time for all Republicans in Virginia to unify behind their leadership. I was shocked by the verdict against President Trump. Here's my statement from last week. **My Statement on the Trump Guilty Verdict:** _"We live in a two-tiered Justice system where the politicization of our legal process has given us kangaroo courts with fixed, sham verdicts. It didn’t start today, and it will not end today. But the verdict in the Trump trial is evidence: If they can do it to Trump, they can do it to you. We must restore equal Justice under law and the rule of law. This starts by taking back our country in November and re-electing Trump. If we fail to be successful in that regard, America as we know it is lost. Join me in praying for our country. May she persevere forevermore."_ One more thing about tough fought elections? There's only one winner. I'm anticipating a close race in this primary for the Republican nomination to face career politician Tim Kaine, just like the race against Biden will be close. I'm asking for your support. I'm asking for your money
---

---
| | And I'm asking for your vote. Starting tomorrow, many Virginians will see a TV advertisement from my campaign.
---
---
But we're still a little short on our budget to get my message of ending the illegal alien invasion, stopping inflation, and standing up for kids against indoctrination. It's not too late to fight back and save America. Please help with a campaign contribution to help me close the gap and help me continue on the path to victory on June 18. For Freedom, Scott
---

Dear President Trump,

**God bless you!**

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

**So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU! **

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

_**Thats why:**_

__**WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.**__

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

_**Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!**_

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Our nation’s history is unifying
body:
Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education

Hillsdale College | | | This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6_yoOvJQErV3shqx5ZHdxQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQHr6P0S_~) Fellow American, [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6_yoOvJQErV3shqx5ZHdxQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQHr6P0S_~) You may be discouraged by the Left’s dominance in our colleges and universities, and its increasing influence in K-12 education. But we must not lose hope. Instead, we must fight back with the truth. Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education from the beginning. That’s why we’ve turned our course, [**“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6_yoOvJQErV3shqx5ZHdxQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQHr6P0S_~) into a DVD set, and I’d like you to have a copy. Taught by historian Wilfred McClay and based on his recently published history of America, **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** presents a full, unbiased account of America’s past. Hillsdale’s goal in producing this course is to **restore the kind of intelligent patriotism—especially among our young people—that is essential to preserving free government.** **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project,” which is injecting the idea that America is an essentially unjust nation into the curricula of America’s K-12 schools. Folks,

**The Crazy Left must think I'm as blind as a bat flying in morning fog.**

I recently wrote a beautiful op-ed (if I do say so myself) about defending women from six-foot-four-inch hairy men infiltrating and dominating women's sports. I was proud to have it published in USA Today's newspapers.

Then, when I tried to pull it up online and show my friends, I couldn't find it anywhere. I looked high, I looked low, but it disappeared faster than Fat Albert on Ozempic.

**They outright deleted my op-ed without telling me and thought the public would never notice. Can you believe that?**

name: Travis Christoff
subject: Activate for Templeton
body:
Happy Monday!

If I haven't met you, I am Travis Christoff and I am the Field Director for
Catherine Templeton's congressional campaign for the First District. Thank
you for signing up to get involved on our website. Catherine is building a
grassroots movement to bring seriousness back to the Lowcountry.

If this is your first time receiving this email, I want to welcome you to
our campaign. Catherine will win when we activate her supporters to get out
the vote. Here are some ways you can do that:

1. *Reach Out: *Take 30 minutes today to dig through your contacts that
live in SC-01 (Beaufort, Berkeley, Dorchester, Charleston, and parts of
Jasper and Colleton County). Tell them why you are voting for Catherine and
why they should too. Then, ask them to dig through their lists and do the
same. If you have a list/directory of school, work, and club emails,
consider sending this information to them as well.

2. *Early Vote: *Drag your closest friends and family to go with you to the
polls. This week is the last week of early voting, polls are open from 8:30
AM to 5:00 PM daily. Election Day is on June 11th. See your early voting
location here <https://scvotes.gov/voters/early-voting/>.

3. *Attend an Event:* Attached to this email is our calendar with our
remaining events through Election Day. Please share this graphic with
anyone who will come to see Catherine.

4. *Election Day Team: *We are looking for grassroots supporters to sign up
for shifts at the precincts on Election Day. Volunteers will be holding
signs and telling voters to choose Catherine as they walk in to cast their
ballot. If you are interested in this, please respond to this email.

5. *Text for Templeton: *Ask us for a list of voters to contact in your
neighborhood. We will provide you with a list of Republican voters that you
can tell to vote for Catherine.

6. *Spread the Word: *Nowadays, everyone has a social media page. Please
share your support of Catherine on your Instagram, Twitter (X), Facebook,
or Nextdoor page.

Please let me know if you have any questions, comments, or concerns.

Thank you,
Travis Christoff
Field Director
(940) 781-5772

subject: Peter, I am Running Again for Congress - Taking on Jim Himes
body:
Peter,

I know you were a supporter in 2022 of my Congressional Run. Thank you for that support.

We are running again and there is a Congressional Primary on August 13 with Early Voting.

Are you still in Connecticut? What town are you in?

We can use all the support we can get as a grass roots campaign. And Now we have issues that are particularly important to me with the increased anti-semitism in Connecticut and across our country and world.

Please join the campaign if you can to make calls, send texts or emails and get the word out.

Dr. Michael Goldstein
Candidate for Congress
[www.goldsteinforcongress.com](http://www.goldteinforcongress.com)

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86188909/477110467/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTRmNGQxYS1jNjIxLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jw_dC_MfmyNuLAFHtSxC2akDNkM_38DKlhVYwdi4noM=&emci=e1f54114-c621-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=314f4d1a-c621-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=7731215)

| | Pride is rooted in activism, and this Pride Month, I'm calling for more action. More action to support the LGBTQ+ community. More action to protect transgender kids. More action to stop extremists who attack LGBTQ+ communities. Pride began with the Stonewall uprising in 1969, a pivotal event in the fight for LGBTQ+ rights in this country, and the parades that commemorated the uprising beginning in 1970. Pride has always been about standing up for our right to love freely and openly and to be who we are. **This year, we have so much to celebrate, but we also have so much more to fight for.** Despite the progress we've made, It's painfully obvious that not everyone is guaranteed equal justice in the United States. The LGBTQ+ community faces discrimination and hatred. That's why I continue to fight for equal justice and push for passage of the Equality Act to enshrine protection for LGBTQ+ folks into federal law. In our country, Republican-led states are attacking the LGBTQ+ community, while Democrat-led states are bolstering the rights of LGBTQ+ communities. Republicans have targeted the trans community as their latest political punching bag, passing laws to bully trans children and marginalize entire communities. Our movement is not about you or me. It is about all of us. It is about the fight to protect the rights of LGBTQ+ people, children, and communities and value and love people for who they are. It's a fight that we wage every day. Pride is a time to celebrate, to see how far we have come, and to remember those we lost in the struggle. But it is also a time to renew our commitment to the fight for LGBTQ+ rights, to be allies, and to keep realizing opportunities for equality. Onward! _Jeff_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:

WANT TERM LIMITS IN DC?
WANT A BALANCED BUDGET IN DC?
WANT FEDERAL POWERS LIMITED?
SO DOES COS!
"CONVENTION OF STATES ACTION"**

---
|
Most of you have probably heard of an organization called **Convention of States Action** , or "**COS** ". If you haven't, COS needs your help!

COS is working to hold a [**Convention of States**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=866747a8e5&e=5c740fa3e2). It is a national movement to call a convention under Article V of the United States Constitution, restricted to proposing amendments that will **impose fiscal restraints** on the federal government, **limit its power and jurisdiction** , and impose **term limits** on its officials and members of Congress. Since Congress won't pass legislation to do any of these things, this is how We The People force it upon them!

If this sounds good to you, please sign-up at the COS website [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=f415ea7149&e=5c740fa3e2)**** for national registration and [**ALSO HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=2ee6814bcc&e=5c740fa3e2)**** for Ohio-specific registration, or by clicking the image below.

Dear President Trump,

**God bless you!**

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

**So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU! **

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

_**Thats why:**_

__**WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.**__

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

_**Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!**_

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

body:

| | Team, I’m running for Congress because this seat, and our country, are worth fighting for.

**I never wanted to run for office, but I refuse to sit by and watch Republicans lose another winnable race in Kansas’ 3rd District. Too much is at stake.**

My life story has brought me to this point.

My family came to America from Chennai, India, on the promise of the American Dream. We arrived in Kansas when I was still a child.
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fb489c15fcfdde263947229f28c3afba/e0c27188fb3d9db8c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
I was raised in Kansas, graduated from public schools in Kansas, and set out to live my American Dream.

For me, that meant a bachelor’s degree from Kansas State, a medical degree from the University of Kansas Medical Center, and a career in medicine.
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fb489c15fcfdde263947229f28c3afba/583f153d1b7e2be4c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
American citizenship is the privilege of a lifetime, and I’ve worked every day to make the most of it. I practiced medicine for more than a decade before moving to research.

When the unthinkable occurred on 9/11, my life changed. **I became a citizen, enlisted in the U.S. Air Force Reserve, and am proud to serve as a Lieutenant Colonel today.**
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/fb489c15fcfdde263947229f28c3afba/de09266c7a61a50fc3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
**I’m a cancer physician, a military officer, and an immigrant. I’ve spent my career running towards, and solving, complex problems.**

That’s what we need now, not more talk from the politicians who’ve made every single problem we face even worse.

That’s been my message for the last year.

My Democrat opponent, Sharice Davids, just isn’t getting the job done.

**She votes with Biden and the Squad nearly 100% of the time, so nothing will change if she stays in office.**

**It’s time for new leadership, and I’m the Republican who can unite our party and flip this seat.**

_**My life story, and our campaign’s message, terrifies Democrats. That’s why they’ve already announced huge ad buys against me. It’s critical we have the means to respond to the attacks, share my story, and build a campaign team that can win.**_

_**That’s why I hope you’ll donate any amount to my campaign now.**_
---

Let’s win this!

[Ohio's economic wins come with the responsibility of providing enough energy to meet demand: Sen. Matt Dolan](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)

| [COLUMBUS, Ohio -- So often, I review potential legislation with the thought this is a solution in search of a problem. I am amazed how much attention these bills receive, whether from media, social media or at partisan gatherings around the state. In the meantime, the challenges truly facing our state and nation are in need of solutions.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[I serve on the Senate Energy Committee in the Ohio Senate. And during my time on the committee and traveling Ohio, listening to many businesses, I know a major challenge facing Ohio is energy generation. If Ohio wants to be a leader in job creation and economic development, we must solve the energy creation crisis.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[Because of Ohio's manufacturing base, it is an energy intensive state. Recently there has been incredible economic development success as Intel, Honda, data-centers, and other economic wins have been announced.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[These successes for Ohio bring with them the responsibility of providing enough energy to meet their demands. While at the same time, Ohio must continue to grow its economy and create the jobs of the future. This all requires more energy, and recent reports indicate that we may experience grid stress in the near future - unless we have more generation.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[As is typical of today's politics, energy issues have become binary political divide. One side denounces and limits, the generation of energy by our abundant fossil fuel resources. The other side condemns, as evil, all efforts to maximize alternative energy sources and technology.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[Ohio's future diminishes while "public servants" bicker.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[I recently introduced ](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)[SB-275,](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)[ a bill allowing virtual net metering in Ohio. At its core the legislation is an economic development bill. The purpose of the bill is to provide electric generation through distribution lines (distributed generation) rather than transmission lines. Distributed generation projects can be completed as quickly as one year while transmission level projects are taking 5 to 7 years.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[This distributed generation approach builds off Ohio's current net metering laws. It does not add any tax credits or subsidies for any source of energy.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[SB-275 does not choose sides in the source of the energy. The bill reflects my position of an "all of the above energy" solution. My bill focuses on generating electricity for economic development so, unlike any other legislation in Ohio, the energy created can be powered by alternative energy, natural gas and a host of other energy power sources and technology.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[My bill does not pick a winner and loser. It is a market driven approach by letting the commercial user decide its source.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[My bill also resolves an ongoing political dispute on siting energy projects. Any new energy generation, from any source, cannot be done on agricultural lands. SB-275 limits the development to siting on distressed properties throughout the state. Thus, the legislation will address grid stress while at the same time driving significant private sector investment into redeveloping distressed and under-utilized properties.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[Because this bill is truly an economic development opportunity, it's designed primarily for commercial development and use. Thus, the participating commercial customers will pay all distribution costs thereby preventing utility companies from the need to cost shift to other consumers.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)
[Please contact my office at dolan@ohiosenate.gov for more information. Ohio state Sen. Matt Dolan is a Republican representing the 24th Senate District, which includes portions of Cuyahoga County.](https://ffnhbxdbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSUQWalLOmsByqpCTO35UO5QxQ4-WYBzXLdORTg4d7X1SNr9PxNBKE5YY2q6FslYItJeCpwT31RX9_CpIR_FL6D_jSLdhpoYUCYEpw6AzJnNidltq1BMEFTdvYGZ0utkXyO2ae3D3GsbQ-47YZdDCiH9EK_CMU4ip0LUkUgeBgFFGsz4kN5l2GrcgukdM4jq4msmsnNZbY5-cy6nUi9inYLlEhS-gG0aGnTgp6iMbVOpIbzdAp18anyqmjI1prmdLtKB299NO-N76UFf8h3XCzxzk3ornI-sGQZKFRSKA0lzN-ESgfgLx4Tpz6Vn8x0v&c=J2GhsPZ1mFhqy9luJG-4MtLsIB1A0bJuFU7UtBJYShoMdKNUp4Duzw==&ch=Zhku6slK0DBynPP_rLpKeSm57NdjHuveINHoKosOWIbg8QdkcVCa-A==)

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues **[many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft.** The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: Happy Pride 🌈
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
I'm celebrating our LGBTQ+ community here in Florida and nationwide.
| | |
---
Happy Pride Month, friend! 🏳️🌈🏳️⚧️🎉
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86195810/477130236/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1303-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWUyODE3YjEtZDEyMS1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uv573Fg34XTpf-58GcNHxxeylUTCxYT5V2x2L2etCTw=)
This June, I'm celebrating and uplifting the LGBTQ+ community in Florida and nationwide, and honoring the brave leaders who fought for their equality and civil rights.
Despite the major advancements the LGBTQ+ community has made in the last 20 years, this month, I'm especially mindful of the ongoing fight to protect those rights against the growing attacks from cruel extremist Republicans at all levels of power, with those from our state leading the charge.
**Rick Scott is one of the extremists who use their positions of power to harm the LGBTQ+ community.**
Scott was the governor of Florida when the mass shooting at Orlando's Pulse nightclub took place. After this horrific attack on our local LGBTQ+ and Hispanic communities took the lives of 49 people, including our loved ones, friends, and neighbors, his staff _promised_ he'd sign an order banning discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation and gender identity.
**That never happened.**
And since joining the Senate, he's authored a policy denying the mere existence of trans people and tried to block a law to protect same-sex marriage.
Thanks to the bravery of everyday Floridians, Ron DeSantis' 2022 "Don't Say Gay or Trans" law here at home has been dismantled, nullifying its intended purpose as a tool to discriminate or erase the LGBTQ+ community.
But the fact that it was passed at all proves that the hateful rhetoric and laws pushed by far-right extremists, in Florida or otherwise, is no bluff. And when put in positions of power, these extremists will wield that power to hurt anyone who doesn't look, act, or feel exactly like them. To extinguish their joy. To erase their existence from the fabric of our communities.
**But I know I'm not alone when I say _ya no más_ — enough is enough.**
I'm running to retire Rick Scott because our government should focus on fixing real problems for Americans of all stripes — like safeguarding reproductive health care access, defending our democracy, and protecting key benefits — **_not_ excluding and oppressing the very people we are elected to serve**.
In the House, I co-sponsored the Equality Act to strengthen anti-discrimination protections for the LGBTQ+ community, women, and more.
**And as Senator, I'll be a proud voice defending LGBTQ+ Floridians' freedoms to live and love as they choose from the extremists dead set on taking them away** —**** starting by getting the Equality Act across the finish line.
But for now, I'm celebrating the LGBTQ+ community in Florida and nationwide as they live and love as their authentic selves, with pride. I hope you will, too.
Thanks for reading, and happy Pride,

Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
|

It's Sean Feucht here— I spent the weekend reflecting on the state of our nation and the state of the world for us as Believers. We know a few things-- while the Lord has sovereignty over all creations on heaven and earth, He has allowed Satan to have temporary dominion over this earth.

Rulers rise and fall, but He remains the same. Psalm 37 reminds us that, "the LORD loves justice," and "the descendants of the wicked shall be cut off." Until the Lord returns, we will battle with evil, both in the physical and spiritual realms. What we CAN do is pray. America needs prayer, our leaders need, and we as the church need prayer.

Happy Pride, Peter!
🏳️🌈

When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public
service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between
pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.

After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by
coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who
they love, I came to realize that I could do both:

I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly
what I did.

When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s
history, (thanks to support from this incredible grassroots team!) I
understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a
difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to
protecting same-sex marriage through the Respect for Marriage Act, I’ve
worked hard every day since to do just that.

That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but
to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted
to make a difference, too.

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, top
Congressional Democrats Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries joined with
House GOP Speaker Mike Johnson and Mitch McConnell to invite Benjamin
Netanyahu to give a speech to Congress. And it’s unclear where some
Democratic party leaders stand on Netanyahu’s speech, even as the Israeli
military bombs civilian tent camps and kills tens of thousands of
Palestinians.

It’s clear where Bernie stands. Bernie said Netanyahu’s speech is a
terrible idea and that he would boycott the speech.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17925?t=1011&akid=6106%2E5885482%2EDeikM4 ][IMG]

Netanyahu has led the onslaught on the Palestinian people, cut off aid,
and broken international humanitarian law. No Democrat should show up to
his speech and Schumer should make every effort to stop this speech.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17896?source=email-20240603&t=1012&akid=6106%2E5885482%2EDeikM4 ]Add your name: Majority Leader Schumer and all Democrats should OPPOSE
Netanyahu giving a speech before Congress!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17896?source=email-20240603&t=1013&akid=6106%2E5885482%2EDeikM4 ]ADD YOUR NAME

Bernie is as clear as anyone when it comes to Netanyahu.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17925?t=1014&akid=6106%2E5885482%2EDeikM4 ][IMG]

Netanyahu’s atrocities in Gaza have become a cynical political tool for
Republicans like Mike Johnson. The GOP cares more about logging political
points than taking any sort of moral position on what the Israeli military
is doing in Gaza. The leader of war crimes in Gaza, destruction, and mass
starvation has no place in front of Congress.

There’s no doubt Netanyahu will use a Congressional speech to spread lies
and lash out at Democrats, just like he did the last time he addressed
Congress. It’s exactly what Republicans want and Democrats should fight it
at every turn.

It shouldn’t just be Bernie saying he’ll boycott a Netanyahu speech to
Congress, it’s all Democrats — especially the Democrat leading in the
Senate, Chuck Schumer.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17896?source=email-20240603&t=1015&akid=6106%2E5885482%2EDeikM4 ]Add your name: Democrats must say loud and clear that they reject
Netanyahu’s planned address to Congress.

When we organize, we win.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

AIPAC is planning to spend $20 million against Jamaal Bowman in the next
few weeks.

The anti-Palestinian group’s super PAC recently spent $2 million for one
week’s worth of attack ads targeting Jamaal, who has been an outspoken
leader for Palestinians’ human rights. Jamaal joined me early on in
demanding a permanent ceasefire. He’s one of the few Congresspeople
speaking out against Israel’s latest attacks in Rafah, and he’s calling
out the U.S. government’s complicity in genocide.

With Jamaal’s re-election just a few weeks away, MAGA Republican
mega-donors are dropping millions to support his opponent through AIPAC.

AIPAC recruited Jamaal’s anti-ceasefire opponent, and has even encouraged
Republicans to register as Democrats in order to vote for Jamaal’s
opponent—carrying out a pattern of interfering in Democratic primaries to
take down Black and brown progressives.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240603-rt-jb.YexHkQ&refcode=em20240603-35111&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35111%2E1203867%2E29VA6D ]Can you split a donation today between my and Rep. Jamaal Bowman’s
re-election campaigns and Justice Democrats so we can withstand AIPAC’s
attacks? Jamaal’s primary is just a few weeks away!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240603-rt-jb.YexHkQ&refcode=em20240603-35111&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35111%2E1203867%2E29VA6D ]Chip In Now

In 2022’s midterm elections, AIPAC and its network of PACs spent $40
million against Black and brown progressives, with most of the funds
coming from Trump-supporting GOP mega-donors.

AIPAC also endorsed more than 100 insurrectionist members of Congress who
voted to overturn 2020’s election. These anti-democratic legislators are
trying to censor discussions of racism in schools and ban diversity
initiatives in public education.

Meanwhile, Rep. Jamaal Bowman has introduced urgent legislation to support
African American history education, and he’s bringing us closer to a
multi-racial democracy where we all have equal rights protected by the
government.

For years, Jamaal has called to condition U.S. funding for Israel’s
military based on Palestinians’ human rights. After visiting my
grandmother in the West Bank, he compared Palestinians’ lives under
Israeli military control to his experience with racist U.S. police
targeting Black people like him.

Jamaal and I understand that marginalized people’s struggles are
intertwined, and we want to make our government work for all of us—not
just the privileged few. Instead of voting to send billions of American
taxpayer dollars to Israel’s apartheid regime, Jamaal is pushing to invest
in our communities’ needs, like public education and utility services.

Since he’s up against billionaires who’ll spend a lot to continue the
unjust status quo, Jamaal needs support from our grassroots movement
between now and his state’s June 25th Democratic primary election.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240603-rt-jb.YexHkQ&refcode=em20240603-35111&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35111%2E1203867%2E29VA6D ]Can you chip in today to re-elect Jamaal Bowman to Congress so he can
keep leading on human rights for Palestinians and for all people? Let’s
send the message that we won’t let Republican donors buy Democratic
elections.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240603-rt-jb.YexHkQ&refcode=em20240603-35111&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35111%2E1203867%2E29VA6D ]Contribute $5

Thank you for continuing to grow our movement for equity and justice for
all,

Rashida

Dear President Trump,

God bless you!

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

Thats why:

WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

Fellow Conservative,

I won’t beat around the bush today—I need your financial support. My primary is TOMORROW, and we’re running dangerously low on critical campaign dollars that we’ll need to ensure we can reach every eligible voter before Election Day. Not only are we running low on campaign funds less than six months before the general election, but we’re being outraised 3-1, sometimes even 5-1.

As I’ve written before, this election will be the most expensive Senate race in U.S. history on a per-vote basis.

In our morning check-in, **[my finance director informed me that we need to raise at least $10,000 from this email today to hit our goal before tomorrow's election.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=2131f5fb9a524e3bb3652802912ad413&_e=_DmnVep1nzCjx8RNk6oFeHtpnfxnbglkpmDVephiN4jvQI9NWu2rKwhl-PCos9E02MhW_UromuRu0rpihh2AjcreCkXlyUaeFM5PFZ19Vp-kv0JuvRt2ukeOHomzkmKuakdTKLqIZ8S_MOyXldyoUlLY5twYMMAypmkKxgfiPO2ih47A8ZI5TaQbfZSoGCUTLfvalDO5n9xtH-Br1meK2HLvLMmVGzVo92jppQQKFr_pzuqfyptNtVENJOMvaZhxaU6iXrrpz85Xu3AEEwZCR1d1pfX_h9tfroS_DTW95S_pLigiC_CxWvV3Mvoem_enqQqUp43N5hR1eV25QzdE6WAXddOtqdOxuRFTUCAXbDqkvh_a_tzAfTJoonOotVg4M2yyq5VwKKroJn-9MdkifcZT22fGRmNj1ME53nNmH543s3XAH0NEH9BNI0muL1CU)**

| | Friend, Did you see the horrific decision that came out of the Supreme Court recently? In _Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP_ , the conservative-majority Court decided that South Carolina’s racially gerrymandered districts were constitutional. While this decision is atrocious, it is not at all surprising. For years now, the Court has been influenced by Leonard Leo and his shady network of dark money groups, including groups that filed the amicus briefs in this case.We have emailed you countless times about the corruption that is plaguing the Supreme Court and our need for a stronger, more enforceable code of ethics for the Justices. The right to vote is one of our most fundamental rights and the conservative Supreme Court Justices, who are being influenced by prominent conservatives, decided against ensuring that Black South Carolinians have equal rights to elect the people they want representing them. **[We need to pass the _Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act_ as soon as possible. This way we can prevent further corruption in our Supreme Court by improving the financial disclosure process, strengthening recusal standards, and creating an enforceable code of conduct for the Court, something that, clearly, it is in desperate need of. Please contribute $10 now and join us in the fight to bring ethics back to the highest Court in the land.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86201521/477143280/-1153425267?refcode=5-30-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRkYzg0NmNlLWRhMjEtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oynZubU4t9d3uVuXu7cD7velx9WR8ZtSB7zSQdiOKYE=)** ECU/LAV Action Fund’s President Tiffany Muller says, “The Supreme Court’s extreme far-right majority isn’t even trying to hide their partisanship anymore, with today’s decision being written by the justice who flew flags supporting a violent attempt to overturn the election. Furthermore, this ruling gives politicians the green light to racially gerrymander districts as they please. This assault on Black and minority voters will only worsen unless Congress takes action and passes the _Freedom to Vote Act_ and the _John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act_.” [**Without the help of every single person reading this, we won’t have the power to get Congress to pass the**** _SCERT Act._****The**** _SCERT Act_****is crucial so we can prevent additional corruption and judicial interference by the ultra-wealthy and powerful. If you want the biases of Justices like Clarence Thomas and the money of Leonard Leo to stop influencing Court rulings, can you chip in $10 so we can keep working together to dismantle the ultra-wealthy’s influence on the Supreme Court?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86201522/477143281/-1153425267?refcode=5-30-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRkYzg0NmNlLWRhMjEtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oynZubU4t9d3uVuXu7cD7velx9WR8ZtSB7zSQdiOKYE=) Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action

body:
And so are the Democratic candidates up and down the ballot you’ve been supporting in recent weeks.

|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86203170/477147426/823540626?refcode=ea.ea06bd71-dc21-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.ea06bd71-dc21-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTA2YmQ3MS1kYzIxLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lNSCsCfvyfKolYVa5fY4FByvmpXbLCUjIhD2d7l_tUw=&emci=d2251f61-bd21-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ea06bd71-dc21-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=1049176)
Peter, before I do anything else this month, I want to say thanks for your help in May. I deeply appreciate your continued support and am grateful to know I can count on you. Most importantly, I want to share that our grassroots team raised thousands of dollars _directly_ for candidates up and down the North Carolina ballot. **A few dollars here or there can make a real difference to the success of Democrats, particularly in competitive state legislative races. Your support will go a long way to helping defeat the far-right Republican supermajority in November.** We’re now five months from Election Day, and we have to keep it up. That is why my team and I will have to continue asking for your help in the months to come. We will ask you to invest in our fight for North Carolina’s future, committing your hard-earned resources to our work for the Democratic nominees who need us. And I know I can count on this team to step up, as you always do, because you know just what is on the horizon. Republicans in Raleigh and Washington have made no secret of their extreme agenda: abortion bans, voting restrictions, and attacks on our democratic process are just the start. body:

Fellow Conservative,

I won’t beat around the bush today—I need your financial support. My primary is TOMORROW, and we’re running dangerously low on critical campaign dollars that we’ll need to ensure we can reach every eligible voter before Election Day. Not only are we running low on campaign funds less than six months before the general election, but we’re being outraised 3-1, sometimes even 5-1.

I remember vividly trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft.** The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

**CAMPAIGN UPDATES FOR JUNE 3, 2024**
**Statement from Flemming Larsen:** On Memorial Day, I had the honor of attending two memorial services: one at Cornerstone Park in Henderson and the other in Boulder City at the Southern Nevada Veterans Memorial Cemetery. As we come together to remember those who gave the ultimate sacrifice for our freedom, I am reminded of the profound truth that we are free because of the brave. Their courage and dedication ensure that we can live in peace. Let's never forget their contributions, and always hold their memories close to our hearts. #RememberTheFallen #FreedomIsNotFree #HonoringOurHeroes
______________________________________________________ Flemming Larsen started as a grocery store butcher and grew a single, small restaurant into a successful chain of steakhouses, employing well over 10,000 people in over thirty years of business. He's had to overcome every hurdle the liberal government has put in the way and wants to remove those hurdles so all Nevadans can achieve their American Dream. ______________________________________________________

Team Larsen is busy and running hard! We will continue to bring you the latest news and upcoming events as we push through this last week until the Republican Primary on June 11. name: Joe Cohn
subject: Tomorrow’s Election
body:
No matter tomorrow’s outcome, the work to better the lives of all Americans will remain my top priority. | | | [](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=665e1a4b9955593d7c2d6c3e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.joecohnforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D663a904fb4790561a3d7479d%26ss_email_id%3D665e1a4b9955593d7c2d6c3e%26ss_campaign_name%3DTomorrow%25E2%2580%2599s%2BElection%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-06-03T19%253A32%253A55Z&w=65a6a2fba85b39036d9f5042&c=b_663a904fb4790561a3d7479d&l=en-US&s=KNc4i-YnUdN3UDRlZMf9_yZhIhQ%3D)
---
| Peter,

As we stand on the eve of Election Day, I want to take a moment to extend my heartfelt thanks to all of you—supporters from near and far, within the district and beyond. Your unwavering support and dedication have been the backbone of this campaign, and I am deeply grateful for every bit of encouragement and every conversation sparked on behalf of our shared vision.

Our district, and our country, needs representatives who are not interested in political games but are dedicated to making a tangible difference. The challenges we face—chaos in Washington, threats to our democracy—demand serious, committed action. This is why I made the decision to run.

Throughout this journey, I’ve been driven by a commitment to defend civil liberties for everyone, protect our democracy, and ensure our families have the support they need to thrive. Our campaign has always been about putting people over politics, and your belief in this mission, even from beyond our district’s borders, has been a powerful testament to the shared values that unite us.

No matter tomorrow’s outcome, the work to better the lives of all Americans will remain my top priority. Thank you for your support, your dedication, and your commitment to making New Jersey’s 3rd district—and our country—a better place for all of us.

With deepest gratitude,
Joe Cohn
---
| | | |
---
Joe Cohn, Democrat for Congress

The Vermont Green even let her borrow their megaphone. = = Next, Becca hosted a meet and greet at the Bagel Cafe in Burlington’s New North End neighborhood. Constituents showed up with great questions, and we discussed pressing issues in Vermont right now. = On Thursday, Becca went to the Professional Firefighters of Vermont convention. She was honored to receive their unanimous endorsement! = Last but not least, Becca filed petition signatures on Friday to appear on the ballot. The August primary is just around the corner! = That’s a wrap on Becca’s week back home. Thanks for reading along! — Team Becca = If you'd like to receive fewer emails and only see our most important updates, **If you'd rather not stay up to date with Becca's work, you can . If you prefer to contribute by check, you are welcome to send a contribution to the campaign at the address below. To comply with Federal law, we must use our best efforts to obtain, maintain and submit the name, mailing address, occupation and name of employer of individuals whose contributions exceed $200 per election cycle. Thank you in advance for including that information along with your check. | Paid for by Becca Balint for Vermont Becca for Vermont P.O. Box 291 Burlington, VT 05402 United States

Peter, The _New York Times_ recently published two damning reports about Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito — both of which describe politically charged flags flying at the Alitos’ homes that tie them to the extreme alt-right movement that tried to overturn the 2020 election. **In response, I led two letters to Justice Alito calling on him to recuse himself from all cases involving the 2020 election, including the Trump absolute immunity case and the January 6 obstruction case to be decided in the coming weeks.** Shockingly, Justice Alito felt compelled to respond to our letters — which in and of itself should have been a sign to him that recusal is appropriate to preserve the integrity of the Court — in which he both failed to address Supreme Court precedent, applicable federal law, and the Constitution _and_ egregiously misapplied the standard for recusal in the Court’s non-binding, unenforceable code of ethics. **In truth, Justice Alito’s explanation for his refusal to recuse further supported the necessity for him to recuse.** By refusing to recuse himself from these cases in such obvious situations requiring recusal, Justice Alito is on the verge of doing irreparable damage to the Supreme Court. **[Since the Supreme Court clearly cannot police itself, Congress must pass binding and enforceable ethics reforms for the Supreme Court. body:
And every Michigan family.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1260%2E62735%2EwWjIdg)
I was scrolling through my photos last night, and I just had to share this one, Peter:
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/723?t=2&akid=1260%2E62735%2EwWjIdg)
**[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1602?t=3&akid=1260%2E62735%2EwWjIdg)**
It’s one of my all-time favorites from the campaign trail: my son Pierce, perched up on my shoulders (one of his favorite places to be), during the historic United Auto Workers strike last year.
As a single father, my whole world revolves around Pierce. Adopting him is the single greatest decision I ever made — his laughter is my joy, his dreams are my aspirations, and his future is my driving motivation. Every morning I drop him off at school, I’m reminded of the responsibility I bear as his father to shape a world that nurtures, protects, and empowers him to be his best self.
**Peter, I truly believe in a better Michigan — and I’m running for U.S. Senate to deliver it not just for my own son, but _your_ kids, too. **
I want them to grow up in a world where healthcare is a fundamental human right, where workers are treated with dignity, and where the toxic influence of money in politics is overpowered by the will of the people. Their collective future hinges on the decisions we make today, and I can promise you: As Michigan’s next Senator, I’ll make every decision, every vote, with our kids’ futures in mind. I’ll fight like hell and work with Democrats, Republicans, Independents — whoever it takes — to deliver progress on the issues you care about.
**_But I can’t do it alone._**
[**We have less than ten weeks until the primary, and it’s going to take ALL of us working together to win this election. So, I have to ask: Will you please chip in $5 _today_ to fuel our people-powered campaign?**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1602?t=5&akid=1260%2E62735%2EwWjIdg)

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
We are 24 days away from the first Presidential Debate. We are 42 days away from the RNC Convention. We are 155 days away from Election Day. | | | | |
---
| Happy Monday!
_We are 24 days away from the first Presidential Debate.__We are 42 days away from the RNC Convention in Milwaukee.__We are 155 days away from Election Day._
Here’s an update from another busy week in Wisconsin.
**Border Town Hall in Kenosha** Last year, 42 people died from a fentanyl related death in Kenosha County. The failure to secure the border is impacting our families and our community. That’s why I held a border security town hall to hear from attendees and discuss the challenges and policy solutions to secure the border.
---
| I was thankful to be joined by Kenosha County Sheriff Dave Zoerner, Kenosha County Executive Samantha Kerkman, Kenosha Police Detective Pablo Torres, and former U.S. Border Patrol Chief Rodney Scott.
It was an informative and important discussion. If you weren’t able to make it, click the button below to watch the full event!
---
[Click Here to Watch the Full Event!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=1d9e67a5c6&e=e907534017)
| **We’re On The Ballot!** Our team turned in over 2,000 nomination signatures to ensure we’re on the ballot this November. Thank you to all of our grassroots volunteers who signed and collected signatures!
---
| Now, we’re going to hit the ground running and focus on knocking doors, making phone calls, and putting up yard signs in every corner of the First Congressional District.
Want to help out? Click the button below!
---
[Click Here to Join Our Team!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=c11c0fe8be&e=e907534017)
| **My Interview on UpFront** I joined Matt Smith on UpFront to discuss the impact of open border policies on Wisconsin communities and the state of our race in Wisconsin.
The November election is going to determine the future of America. And just like the last 4 election cycles, Wisconsin voters are going to have the final say in who controls the House, Senate, and Presidency.
---
[Watch the Full Interview ](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=8a5490c017&e=e907534017)
|
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

Peter,

I won’t beat around the bush today—I need your financial support. My primary is TOMORROW, and we’re running dangerously low on critical campaign dollars that we’ll need to ensure we can reach every eligible voter before Election Day. **As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dream.

My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

_**My primary is tomorrow, June 4th, and I'm hoping to secure the endorsements of 10,000 conservatives before voters head to the polls.. **_

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues **[many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft.** The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. _**Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.**_ I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

**I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read.**

I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. _And believe me, there are some tales._

I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. Peter, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you. I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. And believe me, there are some tales. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why Our homeland is in danger. Radical Democrats in Washington want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. This FAR-LEFT liberal agenda is assaulting our society, communities, and the American Dream. The Democrats’ grip on power is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to flip the Senate next year is to nominate a strong conservative candidate who can defeat my liberal Democrat opponent in 2024. Over the days and weeks ahead, you’ll receive emails from me and my team as we build our campaign. While I don’t want you to feel obligated to interact with each piece of content you receive in your inbox, I kindly ask you to refrain from unsubscribing from our contact list. The only way to flip the Senate next year is to nominate a strong Republican candidate who can defeat a Democrat in the General Election. If we fail to flip this Montana seat RED next November, we lose our best chance at a Senate Majority for the next DECADE due to the election map at play. This is my most critical mission to date, and Thank you, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." * | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA | Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL. **📣**** _DACA IS NOT ENOUGH!_****Our home is here, and we need citizenship now.**

When I checked this morning we were just over 12% to our goal | | 12 years ago, immigrant youth fought hard to win DACA. The protections have been life-changing for DACA recipients, allowing us to work, go to school, and live freely without the threat of deportation. But the reality is that DACA has never gone far enough to protect immigrant communities. So 12 years later, our message is this: 📣 DACA IS NOT ENOUGH!Our home is here, and we need citizenship now. The DACA program has always been vulnerable to attacks from far-right forces. That’s why the program has been closed to new applications for nearly three years, and it’s why DACA is likely headed back to the Supreme Court once again. This is exactly why we have stressed the need for permanent protections despite all the temporary benefits DACA provides to immigrant youth. And this is exactly why we’re trying to raise $12,000 for the 12th anniversary of the program to fuel our advocacy work demanding more than just band-aid solutions.
