As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97365079d5a445deaa1c8a272b0c3343&_e=zjkDksQm6aKNQYOgyxaaesudVVzwXoxxmpRDmdSefQyGrQ9cqVm2MDQsqJzaBNwM8s5Fs58UA6tNZ5IF5SVkaliVbHAfyk3DD3afYLJnmVgpAH-0D0FVxg5Gi2BwNW5iR0bdT4WW5VAVHD7a_wzqTtsQowaWGBoor4PBJRZiALesW_mj1cnvmSP2GstX9Rw566YCB_02xytTTd-sI6AMWcqcLGxwTfSZNyFhhsN6ATejA8YkA4eAP-b1QYhE2Cv_rSisM_HyU7XTQC6U--36RDV34ST19L0O02JJGLVjtrK0xRe3Krq8bHJnkbw888YNLOc54JmzxhL7vxi7nZM3WzYTR5qwQE0XuFJzcmw8bjaCViPlUBz4_5xZj3e4Anwhkl1-BETgNIfGZ6Z_MGI_dp1k84MXbYIzNp461QLYhlQ%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the **Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights**. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. **That 's why we've turned our online course, ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97365079d5a445deaa1c8a272b0c3343&_e=zjkDksQm6aKNQYOgyxaaesudVVzwXoxxmpRDmdSefQyGrQ9cqVm2MDQsqJzaBNwM8s5Fs58UA6tNZ5IF5SVkaliVbHAfyk3DD3afYLJnmVgpAH-0D0FVxg5Gi2BwNW5iR0bdT4WW5VAVHD7a_wzqTtsQowaWGBoor4PBJRZiALesW_mj1cnvmSP2GstX9Rw566YCB_02xytTTd-sI6AMWcqcLGxwTfSZNyFhhsN6ATejA8YkA4eAP-b1QYhE2Cv_rSisM_HyU7XTQC6U--36RCo7pJDSugIS1bCj8fyicM_Moxa2JUkLoppOjzYVWqAxbuZwpUZQholhg35dMaFw2k1cxlYByq_UJEZaWbpuLWd0R3St6wW6kbab8aaz5oUvZZUfy3_OrR3pZEvy2Gb0t5kZWkd3B0vfJNqtpT0zbVU%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy.** **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6617%2E5257348%2EfhG1yg ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, I was
looking through some old family photos, and I found one that really
resonated with me. I wanted to show you.

Eve and I, with little Lexi and Eli, at the Liberty Bell in Philadelphia’s
Independence National Historical Park:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240603_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6617%2E5257348%2EfhG1yg ]Adam and his family posing for a photo

While Lexi (maybe) and Eli (certainly) may have been too young to remember
this trip, it was important to me to instill in our kids growing up the
pride and patriotism in our country that so strongly motivates my service
in Congress.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=june2024_abs_em.GGnUBV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240603_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=6617%2E5257348%2EfhG1yg ]I want to talk to you about that today, but while I still have your
attention — can you please make a donation of any amount to support my
campaign for Senate ahead of this month’s important FEC deadline? If you
are not yet convinced, read on. I think you’ll like what I have to say.

We took this trip for the same reason that we had Lexi spend so much time
in our congressional campaign offices when she was growing up.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240603_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=6617%2E5257348%2EfhG1yg ]A photo of Lexi phone banking

Why she was attached at the hip (literally!) while I spoke at our
district’s Fourth of July parade.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240603_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=6617%2E5257348%2EfhG1yg ]Adam speaking in front of a crowd while holding his daughter Lexi

Even why I brought her with me to the Capitol, where she met
then-Democratic Whip Nancy Pelosi and had plenty of questions about what
kind of a whip Ms. Pelosi had (and much as I hate to contradict the future
speaker, it was not a candy whip as represented).

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240603_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=6617%2E5257348%2EfhG1yg ]Adam and Lexi posing in sunglasses

We brought Lexi and Eli to Independence Hall so that we could show them
(and recount in the years since) the qualities of what it means to be
patriotic — to be proud to be an American.

In recent years, Donald Trump has tried to twist patriotism into something
unrecognizable. Into something that pits one American against another,
instead of inspiring us to build a more perfect union.

He and his MAGA followers can try to drape their authoritarianism in the
American flag, but they don’t know what it means to make this country a
better place for everyone. They will never know. But I’m sure you do. It’s
why you’re here.

So yes, we wanted to instill those qualities in our kids growing up...but in
the interest of completeness, I also just wanted to spend more time with
them, to share the things I loved with them. It’s just really challenging
raising two small kids while being in office. As any parent can tell you,
every moment you get is precious. And I am grateful to Eve every day for
being the rock our family needed during the many long days and nights I
spent on the House floor.

As it turned out, my kids helped me enormously as a public official,
serving as my North Star. I wanted our two kids to be proud of what their
dad did when he had a chance to serve when it mattered the most. That
feeling only intensified when I had to stand up to the most corrupt
president of our lifetimes when I had to investigate and impeach him for
his abuse of power and worked on the January 6 Committee.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240603_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=1009&akid=6617%2E5257348%2EfhG1yg ]That is my message today,
Derek, and if it resonates,
then I am humbly asking you to pitch in a contribution of
$3 or any
amount. Because I cannot win this fight alone.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

I wanted to take a moment to tell you about my journey to the U.S. Senate and the important lessons I have learned along the way. **[Will you take just two minutes out of your day to read this personal message?](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=333347f575ff4a5f9b8ba3ed6d028fd5&_e=jXKXepEVLsu6nmRnRT3hFJHU1Paot9pdbdcZtoKx0Q5KA9mTzV_s8W-zFfZvg1xR1Wks6t69GpVz3pPIsF0R_bBz-WbdXp16p4xBBn5svDRqAVTBOZ3JizbiwzgMjEixWIIR8IgfmwfNuLbzRYN-9wINmTvw_MhGEJPCy85YwhAZus495TmtjHysTCRywumYJAY0JdwEkG9b6mNj9G3oar6vBOGDytXdveY986L9FPnuFgxadX_NkGTM8cIm2SIHVoK2mmvK2IToqyfz8p_juSVhQj8VrH5_b-FzF-kjoAfhpYi7Q9WDx1Ett5scwziqmHFhTnQKxBxhiwqJsppJ-RI0FTIpd3Cgw_3sM7PwsKnu1m_PHH3OUhjqWpb0uTzCpEeqBEf-1MedMHOdM150AA%3D%3D)**

Chairman John Barrasso,
Senate Republican Conference

* * *

**A Message from Senator John Barrasso:**

[](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=333347f575ff4a5f9b8ba3ed6d028fd5&_e=jXKXepEVLsu6nmRnRT3hFJHU1Paot9pdbdcZtoKx0Q7ieYLgPT27dfR6BD-q4gzLA2GRNVScAgPODL6ag4dnoSSropcheHtMl6lDm3ugB0yVVyHmfs46yrvO-X-hiFAnOIXWDMMRooD5iMWbXkteD81RLTTFfyXJbV_wlPdJn9KES5WMjKjQziRk7ak6nzP0Ahq-YvG2Kv8IIzJTRf9MZW8ds7wcjW9CEsPcXTQ8xu2M6aCBvGAqdymJ8kqsk8xJjO1UAgbN6LaSYxCFUjgzCQ%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _" Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=333347f575ff4a5f9b8ba3ed6d028fd5&_e=jXKXepEVLsu6nmRnRT3hFJHU1Paot9pdbdcZtoKx0Q7ieYLgPT27dfR6BD-q4gzLA2GRNVScAgPODL6ag4dnoSSropcheHtMl6lDm3ugB0yVVyHmfs46yrvO-X-hiFAnuj9iBVzDNsTlLprpy5GBsWMmOWR_s_-18BoeqVkxTOw6pJYHDZhtfmslg1QLJM8mglSfcr3GEb5SuERoLDF37VKw4SUij7zZhA_YBpOib0r2NcEqJqG1SMjYZ7DhlLMywx0tgKH5TFaXh8NnWjdSmg%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=333347f575ff4a5f9b8ba3ed6d028fd5&_e=jXKXepEVLsu6nmRnRT3hFJHU1Paot9pdbdcZtoKx0Q7ieYLgPT27dfR6BD-q4gzLA2GRNVScAgPODL6ag4dnoSSropcheHtMl6lDm3ugB0yVVyHmfs46yrvO-X-hiFAn75Mf0pQ_my9RIe_W-LWFxkego3A-lN7bmpdAPPqPBVycMbRJb-BtiRzq1Fj-x2sCCltNa6R5Bmt4cGpNMCPfmmkMrPDzCHXQA7Xdpbf-WE4xZ0Wv-z7CHlh1wb-X-eXcHAD_XGvVtmEjkHjkThSd0A%3D%3D)

Fellow Patriot,

Do you remember how you felt when you saw the news about the horrific attacks against Israel on October 7, 2023?

The 3,000 rockets fired...

The Jihadist paragliders breaching the Israeli border to attack innocent civilians...

It still makes me sick to think about what these innocent people went through, especially the women and children.

This was radical Jihad terrorism--plain and simple. You would think that this would be something we could all agree is evil, no matter our political party.

But since that day, the pro-Hamas Left has instead chosen to ramp up its anti-Israel hatred. They are even shutting down our colleges and universities!

They've blockaded our bridges and roads to push their dangerous agenda. They've spread misinformation about Israel online and throughout our society. And these radical agitators have infiltrated university campuses across America to mislead students and paint our closest ally as evil.

It's revolting.

At times like these, it's critical that we combat such lies with facts, and that's why I'm reaching out to you today.

Young America's Foundation just launched a new eBook called _The Five Myths About Israel Perpetrated by the Pro-Hamas Left_ , and I want to make sure you get your free copy.

subject: Have you heard of scam PACs?

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38883%2E3422442%2EbRUfGv)
Derek, have you heard of scam PACs?
They’re political action committees that raise money under the pretense of supporting certain causes or candidates, but then spend most or all of the money they raise on “consultants” instead.
They’re a shameful way to make a quick buck. Politics shouldn’t be a get-rich-quick scheme for consultants with no morals or conscience.
Unfortunately, a new article from the _ABA Journal_ highlights scam PACs could be on the rise:
Scam PACs are some of the worst offenders when it comes to the more deceptive and cynical fundraising tactics: Things marked with “Warning: Payment Incomplete” to scare people into donating under false pretenses. Or fundraising appeals that promise your contribution will be “400% matched” when no such match exists.
As a consumer protection attorney, Katie has despised these tactics for a long time. It’s why she’s always insisted that our email program be among the most ethical in politics, and it’s why she introduced the Stop Scam PACs Act and SCAM PAC Act to finally crack down on these scammers.

clean_body: We need to use our voices to urge Biden to use his full leverage to force Netanyahu to accept the ceasefire deal. | | | Peter, Last week, President Biden laid out a roadmap to secure an immediate ceasefire, the release of hostages, and humanitarian relief for the people of Gaza. This is encouraging news. But a roadmap is not an agreement — and we’re already seeing signs that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is prepared to reject the proposed deal and continue with his campaign of wanton destruction. President Biden must use every tool at his disposal to push all parties towards an agreement, including halting the shipment of additional offensive weapons to the Israeli military. We need to use our voices to urge Biden to use his full leverage to force Netanyahu to accept the ceasefire deal. As President Biden pursues this pathway to peace, the indiscriminate bombing of Palestinians is still ongoing. Our government must do everything in its power to not only secure a lasting peace, but to stop the death and destruction right now. More than 1,200 Israelis and 35,000 Palestinians have been killed since October 7th, and millions more in Gaza are enduring displacement and famine. If the Israeli government continues its invasion of Rafah, the last refuge for Palestinians fleeing for their lives, the death toll will rise catastrophically. Our government can help to forge a lasting peace, but only if it shows unwavering resolve. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. a scary time for working families

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86216676/477184044/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1338-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmE3OWU4Mi1mOTIxLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mj4NS_ItePOXMsPZ4U0ZmV2744n71_Xup9ywZJk07zM=)
Hi friend, it’s Carole King.
My longtime friend Senator Sherrod Brown is a true champion of workers’ rights. He’s been a reliable vote for legislation that has improved people’s lives.
[**We can’t afford to lose Sherrod’s vote in the Senate! Will you join me in donating $5 or more today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86216677/477184045/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1338-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmE3OWU4Mi1mOTIxLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mj4NS_ItePOXMsPZ4U0ZmV2744n71_Xup9ywZJk07zM=)
As a proud union member myself and the daughter of a teacher and a firefighter, I respect Sherrod’s dedication to fighting for the dignity of work and being able to take care of our family. Working families like the one I grew up in can count on Sherrod to stand up for them every time.
But it's not just workers' rights at stake in this election. Sherrod’s Republican opponent spouts glib talking points in fealty to a MAGA agenda that includes passing a national abortion ban and suppressing the right to vote.
**[Will you donate right now to keep Sherrod in the Senate as a steadfast advocate for fair pay, protecting Social Security and Medicare, and our rights and freedoms?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86216678/477184046/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1338-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmE3OWU4Mi1mOTIxLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mj4NS_ItePOXMsPZ4U0ZmV2744n71_Xup9ywZJk07zM=)**
Friend, **Republicans want to crush us.** They’re running to expand their own wealth and power at our expense. They fall in line to praise their cult leader who wants to be a dictator – and they refuse to say whether they’ll accept the results of the election this year.
**Democrats want to lift us.** Sherrod Brown and his fellow Senate Democrats work every day to solve the problems that keep their constituents up at night.

**We need Senator Brown of Ohio to win decisively in November to ensure that our shared hopes, dreams, and rights are the law of the land.**
[**So please, will you use your grassroots power and contribute right now to reelect Sherrod Brown? Your donation of $5 or $25 is essential to ensure Sherrod’s victory and keep the Senate blue.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86216679/477184047/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1338-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmE3OWU4Mi1mOTIxLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mj4NS_ItePOXMsPZ4U0ZmV2744n71_Xup9ywZJk07zM=)
Friend, your contribution is helping to expand our movement and inspire others who think they can't make a difference because the polls say this or that. Polls, schmolls. The only poll that matters is each of us participating in the process.
I’m doing my part – and I thank you for doing yours.
Wishing you and your family all the best.

– Carole

Today marks the 35th anniversary of the Tiananmen Square massacre. A young student at the time, I remember being glued to the television as hopeful optimism quickly turned into a deadly crackdown. The events kicked off what has been a multi-decade professional interest in China, the repressive Chinese Communist Party, and the apparent certainty of a US-China conflict. Individual liberty was pit against collectivism, a dynamic captured by "Tank Man" single-handedly stopping a column of tanks.
The West remained naive about the true character of the CCP, despite evidence of its brutality. The US slept while the dragon grew ever more rapacious, both internally and externally. The Chinese Communist Party consolidated its power domestically and sought to increasingly project power beyond its borders.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..EXcKq1oKu3cUSxPtwxqxAE3Kv5WMRLfGJAaSNUE7hW4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=145231217)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b889f80e-edf3-4264-93c3-c98c08fce348?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's now apparent to almost everyone that we are in the midst of another great power war, this time between the United States and the People's Republic. And while it's been a "warm" war to date, there is a very real possibility that it could turn hot. While many perceive the current conflicts raging in Ukraine and Gaza as isolated incidents, I don't. I see them as proxy battles in this new global conflict, perhaps even a preamble to World War III.
Leaders, policymakers, and commentators seem to be dividing into two camps with respect to how the United States can best address the rising challenge. They segment based on the impact of American strength. One group believes that strength prevents war, arguing that Reagan's approach to "peace through strength" works. The alternative view is that strength provokes war, a belief that has likely guided the Obama and Biden administrations.
Even after the annexation of Crimea and the Russian-backed insurgencies in Ukraine's east, President Obama remained steadfast in his refusal to send lethal aid to the Ukrainians. He did send non-lethal aid, but as then-Ukrainian President Petro Poroshenko said in an impassioned speech before Congress, "[We cannot win the war with blankets](https://substack.com/redirect/7d9f81ad-c237-45cf-99ed-1ad3cae8bb6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
The rationale was straightforward: Obama didn't want to provide arms to the Ukrainians because he and his team felt doing so would antagonize the Russians. The administration feared the projection of strength would provoke an invasion. The folly of that thinking was quickly made obvious, and Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine demonstrated that appeasement is a proven failure as a deterrence strategy. In the end, blankets didn't prove very useful in deterring Russian tanks.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f47a501c-dc8b-4507-b4e5-7eed082ad2e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A variant of this strategic philosophy was on display during the Iran Deal and its redux under Biden. Pallets of literal cash were delivered in the dead of night, sanctions lifted, and the butchers of Tehran coddled--all driven by the mistaken belief that mollifying the mullahs might tame the terrorists and convince the Islamic Regime that it didn't need nuclear weapons. (It's also worth contrasting the Biden Iran policy with how the Trump administration methodically sought to isolate and contain Iran through a set of agreements known as the [Abraham Accords, in which Arab nations acknowledged and normalized relationships with Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/3ff89b34-7452-40f4-b59f-1d6097326a5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).) To believe these dynamics didn't contribute to October 7th would be naive.
A confused Israel policy was another contributor. Under Obama and then Biden, the U.S. positioned itself away from Israel, to a more neutral stance, in the mistaken belief that it might enable America to be a better arbiter of peace. These efforts always began with criticism of Israel to establish bona fides with Israel's enemies. But what now appears obvious is that only by standing steadfastly behind Israel ( i.e. showing strength) can conflict be deterred. Again fearful that strength might provoke escalation, Biden has been increasingly critical of Israel's actions following the terrorist attacks on its civilians.
The real impetus for today's rapidly spreading world chaos, I believe, was America's chaotic withdrawal from Afghanistan. The rapid retreat, early in Biden's presidency, telegraphed weakness to the world, and our adversaries were soon on the march. As I've said before, when America is strong, our enemies take notice; when America is weak, they take advantage.
Which brings me back to China. **And, more importantly,** **Taiwan**.
The recent Taiwanese election has angered the mainland. Voters gave the ruling Democratic Progressive Party a historic third consecutive presidential victory, defying China's threats that doing so would provoke conflict. In response, China launched one of its most aggressive military maneuvers yet, surrounding the island and demonstrating its ability to cut off any attempt at assistance or resupply of the island nation.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e781c67a-9c3a-40bf-b3cb-fda9ccfd560d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We are now at a crossroads. With the mainland signaling its intent to reintegrate Taiwan into the PRC by force, if necessary, a US-China conflict might be forthcoming. Taiwan could very well be WWIII's Serbia, a spark that ignites a global conflict. Should China try to retake Taiwan by force, America would have to respond militarily; the only other option would be surrendering to an expansionistic Beijing and allowing it take Taiwan. A Chinese controlled Taiwan would disrupt the lynchpin of the "First Island Chain" strategy that has served to contain communism in the far Pacific since the 1950's. A Chinese controlled Taiwan would signal to our other allies in the region that we are an unreliable partner. And a Chinese controlled Taiwan would be a _de facto_ admission that China was the most important power in Asia, leading our allies to accommodate China's interests.
Given these dynamics point to two bleak options-- WWIII or a retreat from the Asia Pacific -- it's imperative that American leaders prevent a "heads China wins, tails America loses" scenario. US policy must lower the benefits and raise the costs of a Chinese invasion of Taiwan. **The goal must be to deter China**. Once again, American leaders are debating if US strength will prevent or provoke conflict. Ukraine offers a lesson, one which we must not ignore. Appeasement doesn't work. We need to arm Taiwan and signal to the Chinese that this is a redline they must not cross. We must also be prepared to act, recognizing that such preparation will make conflict less likely. We must telegraph strength. We cannot just send them blankets.
The impact of American strength is likely to be one of the central debates of the upcoming presidential election, and the path the United States chooses will ripple through our foreign policies for decades. The Trump administration and Secretary of State Mike Pompeo were unapologetic in projecting American strength, and the world took notice. Russia, China, and Iran were contained. In fact, the Biden Administration's belief that strength provokes wars may be the primary reason the world is on fire.
The goal of our actions should be to promote peace _and prosperity_ for all Americans. I believe in an **America First** foreign policy, but that does not mean American alone. We can and should support our allies, not because they're our allies, but because it's in America's interests to do so. And let me go further by noting that **deterrence is cheaper than fighting wars**. While it's hard to project the potential costs of a hypothetical war, it's clear that prevention is cheaper.
Let's be honest, we're in a great power conflict with China right now. Russia, supported by China, invaded Ukraine, which has been supported by the United States. Hamas, backed by Iran (allied with China), attacked Israel, an American friend in region. These proxy wars are part of a greater conflict. But the proxy wars might turn into an actual US-China war over Taiwan, a battle that would adversely impact American prosperity as the costs of such a war would likely be high. Now, perhaps more than ever, it's critical that America telegraph strength and unwavering support for Taiwan.

The rapid retreat, early in Biden's presidency, telegraphed weakness to the world, and our adversaries were soon on the march. As I've said before, when America is strong, our enemies take notice; when America is weak, they take advantage. Which brings me back to China. And, more importantly, Taiwan. The recent Taiwanese election has angered the mainland. Voters gave the ruling Democratic Progressive Party a historic third consecutive presidential victory, defying China's threats that doing so would provoke conflict. In response, China launched one of its most aggressive military maneuvers yet, surrounding the island and demonstrating its ability to cut off any attempt at assistance or resupply of the island nation. We are now at a crossroads. With the mainland signaling its intent to reintegrate Taiwan into the PRC by force, if necessary, a US-China conflict might be forthcoming. Taiwan could very well be WWIII's Serbia, a spark that ignites a global conflict. Should China try to retake Taiwan by force, America would have to respond militarily; the only other option would be surrendering to an expansionistic Beijing and allowing it take Taiwan. A Chinese controlled Taiwan would disrupt the lynchpin of the "First Island Chain" strategy that has served to contain communism in the far Pacific since the 1950's. A Chinese controlled Taiwan would signal to our other allies in the region that we are an unreliable partner. And a Chinese controlled Taiwan would be a de facto admission that China was the most important power in Asia, leading our allies to accommodate China's interests. Given these dynamics point to two bleak options-- WWIII or a retreat from the Asia Pacific -- it's imperative that American leaders prevent a "heads China wins, tails America loses" scenario. US policy must lower the benefits and raise the costs of a Chinese invasion of Taiwan. The goal must be to deter China. Once again, American leaders are debating if US strength will prevent or provoke conflict. Ukraine offers a lesson, one which we must not ignore. Appeasement doesn't work. We need to arm Taiwan and signal to the Chinese that this is a redline they must not cross. We must also be prepared to act, recognizing that such preparation will make conflict less likely. We must telegraph strength. We cannot just send them blankets. The impact of American strength is likely to be one of the central debates of the upcoming presidential election, and the path the United States chooses will ripple through our foreign policies for decades. The Trump administration and Secretary of State Mike Pompeo were unapologetic in projecting American strength, and the world took notice. Russia, China, and Iran were contained. In fact, the Biden Administration's belief that strength provokes wars may be the primary reason the world is on fire. The goal of our actions should be to promote peace and prosperity for all Americans. I believe in an America First foreign policy, but that does not mean American alone. We can and should support our allies, not because they're our allies, but because it's in America's interests to do so. And let me go further by noting that deterrence is cheaper than fighting wars. While it's hard to project the potential costs of a hypothetical war, it's clear that prevention is cheaper. Let's be honest, we're in a great power conflict with China right now. Russia, supported by China, invaded Ukraine, which has been supported by the United States. Hamas, backed by Iran (allied with China), attacked Israel, an American friend in region. These proxy wars are part of a greater conflict. But the proxy wars might turn into an actual US-China war over Taiwan, a battle that would adversely impact American prosperity as the costs of such a war would likely be high. Now, perhaps more than ever, it's critical that America telegraph strength and unwavering support for Taiwan. | | ---|---|--- VIKRAM MANSHARAMANI is an entrepreneur, consultant, scholar, neighbor, husband, father, volunteer, and professional generalist who thinks in multiple-dimensions and looks beyond the short-term. body:

Friend --
As you know, Michigan's Republican Senate primary is coming up soon. And in the weeks before the race, GOP candidates in our race and others are talking to people trying to capture something called "voter IDs."
A "voter ID" is just a simple declaration of support from potential voters.
It is a campaign contacting a voter, and a voter saying "Yes, I support you," or "no, I am supporting someone else."
These replies are the foundation of any campaign, because it’s how we know where our supporter base exists and who we need to turn out in November.
Before the election, campaigns try to make sure their stated supporters vote. And at other times -- especially when a candidate needs it most -- they will turn to those supporters for help.
So today, we are doing the same. We are asking you to add your name as a "Personal Endorser" of Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate. It's a small and simple act, but it will speak volumes about the grassroots support for our campaign:

body:
If there’s one thing that day proved to me, it’s that every single vote counts.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240603&t=1&akid=766%2E587540%2ECfFZb4)
Peter, want to hear about the wildest election night I’ve been a part of since we launched Leaders We Deserve?
Last week, we were in Houston, TX supporting our endorsed candidate Molly Cook for Texas Senate in the Democratic primary runoff.
Earlier in the day before polls closed, I was out knocking on doors to help get out the vote and I knocked on the door of a 20-year-old named Kai. When I told him about Molly and the election he said she sounds great, but immediately asked **“what corporations are funding her?”**
I was able to say **none are** — because as a Leaders We Deserve endorsee, she agreed not to take _any_ corporate donations.
Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation.
**[Pitch in $5 to support our work »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240603?recurring=yes&refcode=em20240603&amount=5&refcode2=766_587540_CfFZb4&akid=766%2E587540%2ECfFZb4)**
I immediately saw his face shift from a look of suspicion to excitement. He then said “I don’t usually vote in elections for state legislature, but she sounds awesome.” So I got his phone number for the campaign to make sure he got out and could vote — **and he did!**
Later, at the election night event where we were watching the results come in, the tallies showed Molly down by about 400 votes for most of the night. A ton of people actually thought she had already lost.
But at midnight, with all the votes finally counted, **she was up 74 votes** — and today she’s the youngest, most progressive, and first openly LGBTQ+ member of the Texas State Senate as a result.
**If there’s one thing that day proved to me, it’s that every single vote counts.** If Kai and just a few others like him had stayed home, Molly wouldn’t have won. But because we were there knocking on doors and making the case for our candidate, she did.
We’re working to elect even more great candidates this year, Peter, but we need your help. Just like each one of our endorsed candidates, Leaders We Deserve doesn’t take corporate donations. We rely entirely on grassroots support to keep up our work.
**[So if you’re ready to help, will you start a monthly recurring donation to Leaders We Deserve today so we can elect even more young progressives like Molly this November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240603?recurring=yes&refcode=em20240603&refcode2=766_587540_CfFZb4&akid=766%2E587540%2ECfFZb4)**

Thank you for everything you do,
David Hogg

Dear friend, In the heart of every rural community lies the spirit of resilience, unity, and hope. Today, we invite you to be a part of a movement that embodies these values and drives real change for all Americans. If every person on our list pitches in $1, we’ll soar **three months ahead** of our fundraising goals. That means more resources to **support Democratic candidates who champion rural interests** , more capacity to engage in **vital grassroots organizing** , and more impact in **amplifying the voices of our communities**. Your dollar isn’t just a drop in the bucket; it’s a ripple that can turn into a wave of change. It symbolizes your commitment to building a future where every rural American has access to quality healthcare, education, and economic opportunity. We understand times are tough, but your small investment today can yield immense returns tomorrow. Together, we can build a stronger, more resilient future for rural America. **We need the House, Senate, and Presidency** to accomplish change in 2024. It's possible, and it's vital if we want our democracy to withstand the attacks on our civil infrastructure waged by MAGA Republicans. **We need to pass legisaltion for reproductive rights**. These next years a crucial tipping point as we get closer and closer to 1.5 degrees celsius of global warming. We already spent last summer under a haze of wildfire smoke.
